layout.lra_v1/admitted/rel__s{k}__{t}/: admitted teachers (model.pt, heads, release; verified copies of the cbp admitted artifacts) + ADMISSION_RECEIPT.json
layout.lra_v1/inputs/: the authorised 83-column deployment input and schema
layout.lra_v1/run/units/pol__*: admitted D0 codes (qpc formats; mean-teacher decoder)
layout.lra_v1/run/units/dec__*, new__*, diag__*: D1 codes (dec__ fixed-map decodes incl. CLASS|D1, new__ fits, diag__ diagnostics): policy.json (token map; its token_proto are D0 means and are NOT released) + decoder.json (learned decoder: sufficient statistics, released vectors, certificates) + release.npz; new__ units also hold the mapper trace.json (starts, accepted moves, statistic hashes, termination)
layout.lra_v1/run/units/d0s__*: same-map D0 diagnostics: the mean-teacher decoder on a new map's unchanged tokens (decoder-only baseline)
layout.lra_v1/run/units/cor__*: correctness-stage units (the pinned known laws under CORRECTNESS_LOCK; no Adult data)
layout.lra_v1/run/units/aud__*, outer__*: inner audits (AUDIT_FIT / INNER_SELECTION) and the locked assessment units (attacker predictions; private)
layout.lra_v1/run/units/tea__*, ref__*, fine__*: teacher outputs, references, label-blind fine partitions
layout.lra_v1/run/*.jsonl, *.log: activity, compute and semaphore ledgers, stage logs
layout.lra_v1/run/units/<unit>/: atomic study units: files + record.json + COMPLETE.json
layout.dependencies/jcv_v1/inputs/adult_jcv.npz: the pinned source input (sha256 e0d9e54a...2f12), bundled so the copy restores alone

restore: copy <PRIVATE_CACHE>/lra_v1_local_copy_20261007/lra_v1 to <PRIVATE_CACHE>/lra_v1 (only if the live store is lost)
verify: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS (inside the copy's folder)

re-run the restore checks: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=. <python> -m lra.sema --label F:closeout -- env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=. <python> -m lra.closeout backup --dry-run --targets <targets.json>
